what_it_changes: Run the capability and long-horizon stages independently inside one already-bounded live request, persist both stage outcomes, and aggregate failure only after both stages have been attempted.
applicability: bounded genuine-model development campaigns that request both capability and long-horizon evidence
non_applicability: unbounded retries or extra workflow runs

supporting_evidence.finding: Recent live Copilot campaign failures caused the current shell's set -e behavior to skip the explicitly requested long-horizon stage, leaving less falsifiable evidence from the same bounded request.
PR 163 made future request commits observable without changing campaign bounds, scoring, or evidence admissibility, so per-stage outcomes can be retained without weakening the claim gate.
